§3Optional. Two of them, both raised by the same projection.§r
A 17x17x20 hyperboloid shell on the platform strip to your §9LEFT§r as you stand at the front and look at the silo face - where step 3's plan view draws them. One stands out §9in front of§r the silo face and one §9behind§r the shell, which is what the panel means by the §9FRONT-LEFT§r and §9BACK-LEFT§r tower. They are §9pieces of the main controller§r, not modules: no tower controller, no dock marker, and no maintenance hatch of their own.

[note]§1A tower that has blocks standing and still refuses to form says WHY, on every panel.§r The REACTOR group carries a §9Cooling towers:§r line of its own - §2Cooling Tower x1§r, or §8no cooling towers§r when there are none - and a failing one appends §cFRONT-LEFT tower NOT FORMED:§r or §cBACK-LEFT tower NOT FORMED:§r with the reason. §8That line is on every panel in every state, silo or no silo. It has to be: towers can go up long before the Silo Control Block exists, because that block IS one of the silo face's own sockets.§r[/note]

§3THE FOUR PLANT MODULES§r
Four MORE optional pieces of this same controller, raised by this same one projection, each on a patch of platform no silo tier can ever reach - so none of them moves when you re-tier. They share a §9Plant modules:§r line on every panel, in every state, faults and all.
Each has its own blueprint on the row below: §9Vent Stack§r, §9Switchyard§r, §9Extraction Derrick§r and §9Enrichment Annex§r.
§8A hatch in a module's socket belongs to that module alone: it never feeds the reactor, and no reactor hatch ever feeds a module.§r

[warn]If this plant is pushing more than§9 100,000,000 EU/t§r, read §9The 100M Wall§r before anything else on that row. Without the Switchyard, every EU/t above that figure is thrown away.[/warn]
